=== `rdf_persistence`

[cols="2,1,6",options="header"]
|===
|Name |Kind |What it is

|`AccessRules` |class |Decides whether a caller may take an action on the tenant or on one of its aggregates.
|`AccountSummary` |class |What the identity port reports about one account of the identity provider: its id, its login name, its email (a service account has none), whether it may sign in, and its global roles.
|`Action` |class |The actions a rule can name.
|`Activity` |class |Something that happened and generated or changed entities, carried out by principals.
|`Add` |class |An activity that added an aggregate.
|`AggregateKey` |class |A key across aggregates, as the runtime reads it from the schema: no two aggregate roots of one class in a tenant's database hold the same values for its predicates.
|`AggregateRoot` |class |A mixin for classes whose instances are aggregate roots.
|`Authorised` |class |What a route's access check settled: the caller's principal, its access to the tenant, and the IRI of the tenant or aggregate it was checked on, which the route then acts on, and the global roles the token granted the caller.
|`BadQuery` |class |The store refused the SPARQL text as malformed.
|`BlobEntry` |class |One object in a tenant's bucket, as a listing of the bucket reports it.
|`bootstrap` |function |A bus with the toolkit's ``Transition``, ``PostComment`` and ``PostReply`` handlers (each unless ``commands`` names its class; there is none for ``DeleteFile``) and the handlers and observers given, each with the ``dependencies`` its parameters name bound (PD-14).
|`CallerAccess` |class |What the access check needs to know about one caller in one tenant: the tenant's state, and the grants and prohibitions of the access record that name the caller.
|`Collaboration` |class |What a caller may ask of a tenant beyond one aggregate at a time.
|`command` |function |A command of ``cls`` with a fresh ``urn:uuid:`` id.
|`Comment` |class |A remark on an aggregate, or a reply to another remark.
|`CommitMarker` |class |The registry marker of one transaction's commit: a fresh IRI per transaction, written first in the single request, so the writes that follow apply only if it was written.
|`CommitTooLarge` |class |A unit of work holds more roots than its ``max_roots``; commit fewer, or in batches.
|`Conflict` |class |The write lost a race, or the thing to create already exists.
|`context_link` |function |The JSON-LD context link of an envelope: ``{public_url}{prefix}/context.jsonld``, relative (``{prefix}/context.jsonld``) without a public URL (D-16).
|`DatabaseGone` |class |The dataset a request names does not exist (it was dropped, or never created).
|`DatabaseKind` |class |The databases an aggregate can live in, the values of the database annotation.
|`DEFAULT_IRIS` |constant |
|`DeleteFile` |class |The activity of removing a stored file, with the file aggregate it used and an invalidation of it.
|`Described` |class |A mixin giving an object an IRI, a label and a description.
|`DirectorySettings` |class |How the user directory of the identity provider is read.
|`EventBus` |class |Base class for protocol classes.
|`EventEnvelope` |class |What travels beside an activity on the event bus: the tenant it happened in, the deployment that published it, the class of its body and where to find the JSON-LD context that reads it.
|`EventSettings` |class |The event bus, the relay that publishes from the outbox, and the hub that fans events out.
|`FileStore` |class |An object store with buckets, over S3 or in memory.
|`Forbidden` |class |The caller may see the thing but is not allowed the action (403).
|`FusekiStore` |class |A ``Store`` over Fuseki's SPARQL, Graph Store and admin endpoints, with basic auth.
|`generated_models` |function |The generated classes of ``modules``, for ``Mapper``.
|`Generation` |class |The generation of one version of an entity by an activity.
|`Grant` |class |A permission given to a principal on a tenant or on one aggregate, either by role or as a direct action; exactly one of role and action is given.
|`GrantSet` |class |The body that replaces the grants and prohibitions of a tenant; two grants with the same assignee, target and role or action are refused.
|`GrantValidator` |function |
|`GraphKind` |class |The special graphs a class can live in, the values of the graph annotation.
|`HttpSettings` |class |The timeouts and the attempts of every HTTP client of the toolkit: the SPARQL store, the identity provider and the object store.
|`Identity` |class |Find, list, disable and enable accounts, and grant and remove their global roles.
|`IdentityUnavailable` |class |The identity provider's keys or management API cannot be reached, or answered with a server error.
|`IdKind` |class |The ways an id is drawn.
|`IdSource` |function |
|`IdSpec` |class |How the toolkit draws an id: a UUIDv4, or `length` characters drawn from `alphabet`.
|`install_service` |function |Serve the application's schema on ``app``: its routes, its problem responses, its start-up.
|`Invalidation` |class |The invalidation of one version of an entity by an activity.
|`InvalidBody` |class |A request body is not a valid representation for its route: it fails the shape, names an IRI the client may not choose, or describes another aggregate than the one in the path.
|`InvalidGrant` |class |A grant or prohibition targets something that is not the tenant or the graph of one of its aggregates, or names an assignee that is not an IRI.
|`InvalidGraph` |class |A file of RDF does not parse; the message is the parser's.
|`InvalidIri` |class |A value breaks an IRI, path-segment or resource-name rule of the toolkit (``domain.layout``, ``services.iris``).
|`InvalidMigration` |class |A migration file cannot be read, is not a migration, or holds a step that is a draft or fails the checks.
|`InvalidRoleDefinition` |class |A file of role definitions cannot be read or holds an entry that is not a role definition.
|`InvalidToken` |class |An access token is missing, expired, malformed, signed by an unknown key, or for another issuer or audience.
|`InvalidWorkflow` |class |A workflow file cannot be read, is not a workflow, or contradicts itself, the role definitions or the schema.
|`IriPolicy` |class |The templates the toolkit mints and accepts IRIs by, one per kind of IRI, and the id specifications of tenant and object ids.
|`Iris` |class |Every IRI of a service, minted and checked by the templates of its IRI policy.
|`JwksSettings` |class |How the token verifier caches the identity provider's keys and which signatures it accepts.
|`JwksTokenVerifier` |class |Verifies JWT access tokens against the keys of an OIDC issuer.
|`KeyConflict` |class |A commit claims a value of a unique key that another aggregate of the tenant holds.
|`KeyDuplicate` |class |A set of aggregate roots of one class that hold the same values for a key across aggregates, found in a tenant's database by the duplicates report.
|`LabelUpdate` |class |The body that replaces the label of a tenant.
|`limited_body` |function |The body of the request, if it is at most ``limit`` bytes.
|`LimitSettings` |class |The most the toolkit takes in one message bus run, one commit, one body and one restore manifest.
|`Listings` |class |Turns a ``ListRequest`` into a ``ListPlan`` against the classes of one schema.
|`load_caller_access` |function |The tenant's state and the grants and prohibitions that name ``principal``, in one query.
|`load_role_definitions` |function |The role definitions in the YAML file ``path``, validated against ``rp_access``.
|`load_schema` |function |Open the schema at ``path``; ``rdf_persistence/model/<module>`` imports find the package's modules.
|`Mapper` |class |Maps the generated classes of a schema to and from the triples of an aggregate.
|`MemberList` |class |The members of a collection that the caller may read, and the number of members left out because the caller may not read them.
|`MembershipRule` |class |The rule of a collection, a part of its graph with no identifier of its own.
|`MessageBus` |class |Dispatches commands to handlers (``handle``) and committed activities to observers (``publish``).
|`MessageLimitExceeded` |class |A message bus started or published more messages in one chain than its ``limit`` allows.
|`MigrationFailed` |class |The system or application database could not be migrated at start-up: the store refused or timed out, the stamp read back is behind, or the stamp is unknown to the chain (PD-11).
|`ModuleKind` |class |The kinds of schema module, the values of the module_kind annotation.
|`Motivation` |class |Why a comment was made.
|`new_part` |function |A part of the aggregate rooted at ``root_iri``, with an IRI minted by ``iris`` (default policy: ``{root}/parts/{uuid4}``); ``tenant`` is the tenant the aggregate is in (PD-3).
|`NotAcceptable` |class |The request's ``Accept`` names no representation the service produces.
|`NotFound` |class |The named thing does not exist.
|`open_session` |function |Open a session on the tenant database ``database`` for ``principal``; ``iris`` is the IRI policy (default: the default policy); ``listings`` lets the session ``find`` aggregates.
|`Page` |class |One page of a listing, with the position of the page in the whole listing.
|`PayloadTooLarge` |class |A request body is larger than the service takes: too many bytes, or too many nodes.
|`PendingLoad` |class |The registry marker of a load not yet committed: one triple saying when the graph was put.
|`PersistenceError` |class |Base of every error this toolkit raises on purpose.
|`Policy` |class |A set of permissions and prohibitions.
|`PostComment` |class |The activity of posting a comment on an aggregate: the aggregate it used, and a generation of the comment.
|`PostReply` |class |The activity of posting a reply to a comment: a post of a comment that also names the comment it answers.
|`PreconditionRequired` |class |An update or a delete came without the ``If-Match`` header that names the version it expects.
|`Principal` |class |A reference to a user account in the identity provider, by IRI only.
|`Problem` |class |An RFC 9457 problem detail, the body of every error answer of the service.
|`ProblemKind` |class |A kind of problem the service answers with: the slug that ends its problem type IRI, its fixed title and the HTTP status it comes with.
|`Prohibition` |class |The ODRL prohibition that forbids an assignee an action on a target; it wins over any permission.
|`Provenanced` |class |A mixin for entities whose derivation, generating activity and attribution are recorded.
|`RdfFormat` |class |The serialisations a file of RDF can be loaded from.
|`Receive` |function |
|`ReferenceCollection` |class |A mixin for an aggregate that collects other aggregates of one class: the members it names, and a rule that says which aggregates of that class belong.
|`Referrer` |class |One aggregate that points at another: its IRI, its schema class and the slot that holds the reference.
|`ReferrerList` |class |The aggregates that point at one resource and that the caller may read, and the number of referrers left out because the caller may not read them.
|`RegistryEntry` |class |An entry of a tenant's registry graph, naming a graph that belongs to an aggregate.
|`RegistryKind` |class |The kinds of graph a registry entry can name.
|`Remove` |class |An activity that removed an aggregate.
|`remove_with_files` |function |Remove the aggregate ``iri`` at ``if_version``, then delete from the tenant's bucket the blobs it named in ``rp:fileKey`` that no other graph names.
|`Replace` |class |An activity that replaced an aggregate with a new version.
|`RoleDefinition` |class |What a role may do and where it applies.
|`RoleLevel` |class |The levels at which a role applies.
|`RootValidator` |function |
|`RpAnnotation` |class |The annotations the toolkit reads from a schema, one entry per tag; any other tag is left alone.
|`RpModel` |class |A pydantic model that refuses unknown fields and validates every assignment.
|`Rule` |class |An ODRL rule that gives an assignee a ruling on an action over a target.
|`S3FileStore` |class |A ``FileStore`` over an S3-compatible endpoint.
|`ServiceKit` |class |The collaborators of the routes.
|`ServiceSettings` |class |The settings of `install_service`: where the service is mounted, how it names tenants and which role its callers get on a tenant they create.
|`Session` |class |Reads and commits whole graphs of one tenant database on behalf of one principal.
|`settings_from_env` |function |Build ``model`` from the variables ``<prefix><SLOT>`` and ``<prefix><GROUP>__<SLOT>``.
|`SlotEquality` |class |One condition of a membership rule, a slot of the member class and the value it must equal.
|`SseSettings` |class |The lifetime, the access check, the keep-alive and the resume window of the events route.
|`Store` |class |A SPARQL 1.1 store with a Graph Store endpoint and dataset administration.
|`StoredDataInvalid` |class |What the store holds cannot be decoded: a fault of the service or its data, never of the request.
|`StoredFile` |class |A mixin for the current content of a kept file; the bytes live in the tenant's bucket under the file key.
|`StoreNotWired` |class |A tenant's record names a store that the service does not wire.
|`StoreUnavailable` |class |The triple store or the file store cannot be reached, or answered with a server error.
|`sweep` |function |Finish the deletions that stopped and drop the databases and buckets no tenant owns.
|`sweep_tenant` |function |Find the orphans of the active tenant ``tenant`` older than ``older_than``; delete the loaded graphs if ``remove`` and the blobs if ``remove_blobs``.
|`Tenancy` |class |Creates, reads and deletes tenants: their databases, buckets and access records.
|`TenantAccess` |class |The access record of a tenant: its label, state and database name, with the grants and prohibitions that say who may do what in it.
|`TenantBehind` |class |A request reached a tenant whose migration failed at start-up and that is set aside (PD-11).
|`TenantCreate` |class |The body that creates a tenant, its label and the slots of the tenant's root object.
|`TenantDump` |class |The manifest of a tenant dump archive, written by `dump_tenant` and read by `restore_tenant`: where and when the dump was taken, which schema and toolkit it came from, the tenant it holds and the IRI policy that minted its IRIs, so a restore can check that the dump was made under the same schema and policy.
|`TenantGone` |class |The bucket a file operation names does not exist: the tenant was deleted, or never created.
|`TenantLabelled` |class |A mixin for what carries a tenant's label, one line of 1 to 200 characters that neither starts nor ends in a space; the access record and the service's request bodies share it, so the label is checked the same everywhere.
|`TenantState` |class |The states of a tenant.
|`TenantSummary` |class |What the service answers about one tenant, in a listing or after creating it.
|`TenantSweepReport` |class |The outcome of a sweep of one live tenant: the loaded graphs and bucket objects found orphaned past the grace period, and whether each list was removed.
|`TokenVerifier` |class |Turns an access token into the caller it identifies.
|`ToolkitSettings` |class |Every group of settings; each group is a new instance of its class with its own defaults, never absent.
|`Tracked` |class |A mixin for the tracking statements of a commit.
|`Transition` |class |One transition of an aggregate, as an activity: which aggregate it used, from which state to which, when, by whom and with which comment.
|`UnderWorkflow` |class |A mixin for an aggregate root that follows a workflow, which its class names with the workflow annotation.
|`UniqueScope` |class |The scopes of a key across aggregates, the values of the rp_unique_scope annotation.
|`UnitOfWork` |class |Object-level access to one session: ``get`` roots, ``add`` new or changed ones, ``commit``.
|`UnknownRole` |class |A grant names a role that no tenant-level or aggregate-level role definition defines.
|`UnsupportedMediaType` |class |The request's ``Content-Type`` is not one the route accepts.
|`VerifiedCaller` |class |What a token verifier returns for a valid token, the principal and its global roles.
|`Work` |class |What a handler or an observer works with.

|`WorkflowTransition` |class |One transition of a workflow, from one state to another, with the roles that may make it.
|`WritesKind` |class |How an aggregate root is written, the values of the rp_writes annotation.
|`zitadel_roles_claim` |function |The claim that holds a project's roles in a token: Zitadel names it after the project.
|`ZitadelIdentity` |class |An ``Identity`` over a Zitadel instance, authenticated with a service token.

=== `rdf_persistence.testkit`

[cols="2,1,6",options="header"]
|===
|Name |Kind |What it is

|`access_token` |function |Get a JWT access token for a machine user with the JWT-profile grant.
|`assert_isomorphic` |function |Fail, with the triples only one side has, when the two graphs are not isomorphic.
|`assert_models_generated` |function |Raise one ``AssertionError`` listing every violation, or return None.
|`assert_public_imports` |function |Raise one ``AssertionError`` listing each import of a module of the toolkit.
|`class_shapes` |function |The shape of every class (mixins and abstract ones too) in the closure of the schemas.
|`create_machine_user` |function |Create a machine user whose tokens are JWTs, with a key, and the given global roles.
|`fake_session` |function |A real ``Session`` over a ``FakeStore``, for unit tests of domain services.
|`FakeFileStore` |class |A ``FileStore`` in memory, with the same failure injection as ``FakeStore``.
|`FakeIdentity` |class |An ``Identity`` over accounts in memory, with the same failure injection as ``FakeStore``.
|`FakeStore` |class |A ``Store`` over one rdflib ``Dataset`` per dataset name, with failure injection.
|`InMemoryBroker` |class |The broker the in-memory buses share: every message sent, as (envelope, JSON bytes).
|`InMemoryEventBus` |class |An ``EventBus`` that delivers to every started bus on its broker, itself included.
|`model_schema_diff` |function |Where a generated model requires a property the JSON Schema leaves optional, or the reverse.
|`model_shape_diff` |function |Where the pydantic fields of the generated classes differ from the shapes (name, required, multivalued); empty when they agree.
|`new_key` |function |A fresh signing key that fits ``algorithm``: RSA 2048 (RS*, PS*), the curve of ES256, ES384 or ES512 (P-256, P-384, P-521), or Ed25519 (EdDSA).
|`no_network` |function |Make ``connect``, ``connect_ex`` and ``create_connection`` raise ``RuntimeError``.
|`open_event_stream` |function |Open ``url`` on ``app``; return its status, headers (``dict[str, str]``, lower-case names) and events.
|`OpenedStream` |class |What opening a server-sent event stream returned: the status and headers of the response and the events read from it.
|`provision_project` |function |Create the project with the role ``admin``, and one machine user per principal.
|`read_snapshot` |function |Read the shapes written by :func:`write_snapshot`.
|`RecordingObserver` |class |An observer that appends every activity it is called with; it never raises.
|`shared_key` |function |One signing key per process, for tests that need a key but not a distinct one.
|`snapshot_diff` |function |Human-readable lines for what differs between two lists of shapes; empty if none.
|`StreamEvent` |class |One event of a server-sent event stream.
|`TokenRefusedError` |class |Zitadel refused a token request (a disabled account, an unknown key, ...).
|`TokenSigner` |class |An identity provider for tests: signing keys, tokens, and the endpoints a verifier reads.
|`wait_until` |function |Call ``probe`` until it returns something truthy, and return that value.
|`wait_until_async` |function |Await ``probe`` until it returns something truthy, and return that value.
|`write_snapshot` |function |Write the shapes as YAML rows.
